mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and SPX 60d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.5% (UNRATE > 9.5%), it signals a weak labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 9.5%, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and SPX 5d returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or the Rank IC between the interaction term and SPX 20d returns is below 0.03 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial contraction (INDPRO < 95.0), manufacturing slowdowns reduce corporate profits and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and SPX 60d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher residential construction permits (HOUST) indicate strong housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST increases, or the Rank IC between HOUST and SPX 5d returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0% (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), it signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation > 3.0%, or the Rank IC between CPIAUCSL YoY inflation and SPX 20d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or the Rank IC between the interaction term and SPX 60d returns is below 0.03 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY < 1.5%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%), the central bank's accommodative stance supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: low inflation and low rates regime
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY < 1.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or the Rank IC between the interaction term and SPX 5d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
